properties.name: Regierungsviertel bounds — task-10 Europacity and southern history expansion
properties.description: Lobed polygon covering the complete task-09 area plus Europacity to the DKB campus Upbeat in the north and the historic Anhalter Bahnhof, WELT balloon and Kochstraße in the south-east. The western lobe continues to cover the complete Großer Tiergarten through Charlottenburger Tor, Café am Neuen See and the Spanish Embassy.
properties.source: Owner-approved task-10 scope, fitted to verified OpenStreetMap positions (Geofabrik Berlin extract dated 2026-08-06). The north lobe follows Europacity instead of taking all of Moabit; the south-east lobe reaches Kochstraße and Anhalter Bahnhof while the south-west corner remains cut away to keep payloads bounded.
